Trying to install Jax with compatible CUDA and CuDNN versions.
`pip install -U "jax[cuda12]"` threw a warning that should've been an error.
`jax_cuda_releases.html` threw neither warnings nor errors (but failed).
`jax_cuda_releases.html` a second time threw errors (and failed).
Never figured out how to install it. 
Likely Conda's poor package management for Cuda-CuDNN compatibility.

Honestly, I'm not sure this is a Jax problem.
It could error out quicker, but there CUDA/CuDNN problems here too.
